clue.text: Story of Leeds and Manchester?

parts.note: Leeds and Manchester are two English cities, so a narrative about the pair is jokingly the title of the Dickens novel set in London and Paris

explanation.definitionFit: The Dickens novel's title literally describes a story about a pair of urban centres, which Leeds and Manchester are.

clue.text: Contest without a single runner

parts.note: in this sports-day event partners are tied together at the leg, so nobody runs alone

explanation.definitionFit: In this sports-day event pairs of runners have adjacent legs bound, so no competitor runs singly.

clue.text: Made a ruling

parts.note: looks like a judge's decision but means drew straight rules across paper

explanation.definitionFit: Paper ruled with straight strokes has been given rows to write on, so ruling is the act described.

clue.text: See former pupil become a waiter

parts.note: OB stands for old boy, a former pupil of a school
to serve is to work as a waiter at table

explanation.surface: An old schoolmate is spotted now working in a restaurant.
explanation.definitionFit: To see something is to notice or watch it, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Theatre collapsed at that place

indicators.note: a building that has collapsed is in ruins, so the letters of the word fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A theatre fell down at a particular spot.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning there, at that location.

clue.text: Type of illusion showing another pilot about to enter

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'another' makes OPTIL from PILOT; 'to enter' puts CA inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: An illusion of the eye is a visual trick, so the word describing sight fits.

clue.text: Emblematic device used by showman stopping short of Brazilian city

clue.text: One's in India or farther east

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, the word with its apostrophe dropped

explanation.surface: Someone is located in India or somewhere beyond it to the east.
explanation.definitionFit: The Southeast Asian archipelago nation lies east of the subcontinent, beyond it in that direction.

clue.text: Bedmate in business?

parts.note: a partner who is asleep becomes the commercial term for an investor who takes no active role in the firm

explanation.definitionFit: A silent investor shares in a firm without working there, figuratively dozing beside the active owners.

clue.text: Coming into new life with regard to northern climb

parts.note: RE means concerning, with regard to
an ascent is a climb upwards

explanation.surface: Someone reborn as they tackle a climb in the north.
explanation.definitionFit: Renascent means being reborn, reviving after decline.

clue.text: Minister, cockney had gone in before

indicators.note: having entered means one piece goes inside another

parts.note: PRE is a prefix meaning before
a Cockney drops the H, so had is pronounced 'ad

explanation.definitionFit: A padre is a chaplain, a minister of religion, especially in the armed forces.

clue.text: Finish with terribly sore back

indicators.note: badly done, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: To back a proposal is to support or approve it.

clue.text: Gain from the elimination of crime

definitions.meaning: to make a large profit, as a verb phrase
a purge of lawlessness, as when police sweep a town

explanation.surface: Profit comes from wiping out lawbreaking.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to make a big profit and a campaign removing crime or corruption.

clue.text: Either way it's an exclamation of surprise

indicators.note: read forwards or backwards the word is the same

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Whichever direction it goes, it is a cry of astonishment.
explanation.definitionFit: A cry voiced on sudden discovery or surprise, a common interjection.

clue.text: Remove property from revolutionary in vandalised seat

indicators.note: something vandalised has been wrecked, so its letters are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written
Che Guevara is the archetypal revolutionary

explanation.surface: Property is taken from a rebel sitting on a wrecked chair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vandalised' makes ESAT from SEAT; 'in' puts CHE inside it after ES.
explanation.definitionFit: Escheat, as a verb, means to confiscate land to the Crown when there is no heir.

clue.text: Schizophrenic jazz fan has a pick-me-up

parts.note: cat is old slang for a jazz enthusiast
a tonic is a restorative drink

explanation.surface: A mentally ill jazz lover takes a restorative.
explanation.definitionFit: Catatonia, a stupor state, is associated with schizophrenia, so a sufferer may be described this way.

clue.text: Lady not in favour of entering dry club

indicators.note: going into means one piece placed inside another

parts.note: AA is Alcoholics Anonymous, a fellowship whose members stay off drink
V is versus, meaning against

explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name, so a woman in crossword terms.

clue.text: One is taken in by a beast making the connection

parts.note: a lion is a wild beast
taken as written

explanation.walkthrough: 'taken in by' puts I, A and IS inside LION.
explanation.definitionFit: A liaison is a link or connection between parties, so this works as a noun phrase description.

clue.text: Charged particle found by one off a Scottish island

indicators.note: taken away from, so the letter is dropped

parts.note: Iona is a small island in the Inner Hebrides
A is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.definitionFit: An atom carrying an electric charge after gaining or losing electrons.

clue.text: Escape through the broken gateway

indicators.note: a broken thing is in pieces, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fleeing through a damaged gate.

clue.text: Apple drinks father rejected

parts.note: wines are drinks

indicators.note: turned back, so the word is reversed

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

clue.text: Admitted having resigned

definitions.meaning: gave up or surrendered a position

explanation.surface: Someone owned up after quitting.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to concede a point and to give up or surrender.

clue.text: Undo one French fastener

parts.note: un is French for one
a clasp is a fastener

explanation.surface: Unfasten a single French buckle.
explanation.definitionFit: To unclasp is to undo a fastening.

clue.text: Sam in America has a right, but it is not definite

parts.note: Uncle Sam personifies the United States

explanation.surface: An American called Sam is entitled to something, but it is vague.
explanation.definitionFit: Unclear means uncertain or vague, not definite.

clue.text: Scale of clues one's compiled

indicators.note: put together in new order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
I is Roman one, plus S, giving one is

explanation.surface: A setter assembles a scale out of clues.
explanation.definitionFit: The centigrade temperature scale, named after the Swedish astronomer.

clue.text: Man taken in by his fiance

indicators.note: contained within the words that follow, so the letters lie inside them

explanation.surface: A man deceived by his husband-to-be.
explanation.definitionFit: A common male first name, so a man in crossword terms.

clue.text: In which strained relations are relaxed

definitions.text: In which strained relations are relaxed

parts.words: In which strained relations are relaxed
parts.note: relations here are diplomatic ties between nations, not family members

clue.text: One getting down to work right behind the dog

parts.note: a collie is a breed of dog

explanation.definitionFit: A coal miner descends into the pit for the shift.

clue.text: Greek king seen at 9.18

parts.note: IX is the Roman numeral nine
eighteen points to the answer at 18-down, the charged particle

explanation.surface: A legendary king is spotted at a quarter past nine.
explanation.walkthrough: 9.18 looks like a time, but it is nine in Roman numerals and the answer at 18.

clue.text: Times an indefinite number had been taken in by a lady

parts.note: ages are long periods of time
N stands for an unspecified number in maths

explanation.walkthrough: 'had been taken in by' puts N inside AGES.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, so a woman in crossword terms.

clue.text: Cube artist produced for food authority

parts.note: a die is a small cube used in games
Titian was a Venetian Renaissance painter

explanation.surface: A Cubist painter creates something for a gourmet expert.
explanation.definitionFit: A dietitian is an expert on nutrition and diet.
